temporary archive inspection retry
args:
python -c "import zipfile,os,shutil,subprocess;exec("base=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'13')
for fn in sorted(os.listdir(base)):
 p=os.path.join(base,fn)
 if fn.lower().endswith('.zip'):
  print('ARCHIVE',fn)
  z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)
  print('CONTENTS')
  [print(' ',n) for n in z.namelist()]
  if 'Java' in fn:
   td=os.path.join(base,'_archive_extract_temp');shutil.rmtree(td,ignore_errors=True);os.makedirs(td);z.extractall(td)
   roots=[r for r,d,f in os.walk(td) if os.path.basename(r).lower()=='src' and any(x.endswith('.java') for x in f)]
   print('SRC_ROOTS',roots)
   for src in roots:
    files=[os.path.join(r,x) for r,d,f in os.walk(src) for x in f if x.endswith('.java')];out=os.path.join(td,'classes');os.makedirs(out,exist_ok=True);print('COMPILE',src,'FILES',len(files));c=subprocess.run(['javac','-d',out]+files,text=True,capture_output=True);print('JAVAC_EXIT',c.returncode);print(c.stdout,c.stderr)
    if c.returncode==0:
     t=subprocess.run(['java','-cp',out,'com.gdb.tests.TestAccountRulesEngine'],text=True,capture_output=True);print('TEST_EXIT',t.returncode);print(t.stdout,t.stderr)
   shutil.rmtree(td,ignore_errors=True)")"
